cards.title: 题型
cards.intro: 例中的英文为本课自编。图画用文字描述，图表数据是虚构的。
cards.src: c2（C2）考试大纲：写作任务说明
rows: 提纲
列出需要展开的内容要点。
Outline: Describe the appeal of keeping a personal reading journal; explain one difficulty in maintaining the habit; discuss a practical way to address that difficulty.
逐条写到列出的要点，不用同一主题下的其他内容代替。
情景
给出背景、对象和交际目的。
Situation: A student committee is reviewing the use of shared music practice rooms. Prepare a proposal explaining a booking problem and suggesting a fair arrangement for users.
按给定的对象和目的写。要求写提案，就不写成个人经历。
图画
通过人物、动作或对比呈现主题。
Picture description: A visitor photographs every exhibit without reading its description, while another visitor studies one object carefully. A caption asks what it means to observe.
依据画面中的关系解释主题，不给人物添加画面里没有的动机。
图表
通过数值及其分类呈现比较关系。
Chart description: In a fictional survey, 20% of respondents preferred repairing damaged bags in March, compared with 45% in September. The chart compares repair preferences over time.
先核对对象、单位和时间。数据只显示差异，不说明原因。

cards.title: 评分档的内容与语言
cards.intro: 评分档描述的是整篇短文。每个例句只展示其中一项表现。
cards.src: c2（C2）考试大纲 第 4.1 节
rows: 13—15 分：内容与连贯
切合题意，表达清楚，行文连贯。
A quiet carriage gives passengers a place to concentrate. Keeping conversations elsewhere therefore protects this space without requiring silence throughout the entire train.
第一句说安静车厢的作用。第二句承接这一作用，并限定建议的范围。
7—9 分：表达清晰度
部分表达不清，其余部分仍能读懂。
Some residents support later opening hours, while others oppose them. This makes it better for them, although they say it should remain the same.
第二句的 this、it、them、they 指代不明，读不出支持的是哪一方。
错误极少，可以有个别错误。句式简单也可以。
A shared equipment list helps volunteers find the tools they need. It also prevents unnecessary purchases when suitable tools are already available in storage.
主谓、搭配和指代都准确。两句都是常见句式，靠的是表达准确。
7—9 分：语言
错误较多，有时有严重错误。定档要看全文。
The workshop give newcomers useful advice. Many participant has little experience, so clear explanations helps them understand the process and avoid repeat the same mistakes.
give、participant、has、helps 和 avoid repeat 均有形式错误。
cards.note: 最后一行改正后为 gives、participants、have、help 和 avoid repeating。例句均为本课自编，不是官方样文。

cards.title: 字数与整体评分

body.p: 不少于 150 词是最低要求，150 词以上都符合。字数够了，只说明满足了这一项要求。内容是否切题、行文是否连贯，要另按评分档判断。

body.box: Draft record: The essay contains 172 words. Its discussion concerns the assigned topic, but several explanations are unclear and language errors occur frequently.

body.p: 172 词满足最低字数。several explanations are unclear 说明部分表达不清，errors occur frequently 说明语言错误较多。这两点都达不到 13—15 分档，字数多也不能弥补。
15% 是写作在全卷中所占的比例，15 分是写作评分量表的满分。切题、连贯和语言准确性共同描述一篇短文，不分项打分再相加。

body.box: Evaluation: The essay addresses the assigned issue, develops its ideas coherently and contains very few language errors. These features should be considered together when judging the complete response.

body.p: 这条评价对应 13—15 分档的主要表现。定到 13、14 还是 15 分，要看完整的文章。一句写对、一段清楚或用了一个难词，都只是局部表现，决定不了整篇的分数。

cards.src: c1（C1）CET笔试：写作；c2（C2）考试大纲：写作任务说明及第 4.1 节

groups.text: CET-6 writing requires one English essay in 30 minutes, with a minimum length of 150 words. Writing accounts for 15% of the paper. The holistic writing scale has a maximum of 15 points. The percentage describes the section's share of the paper, whereas the scale describes the evaluation of the essay as a whole. A draft's word count can establish whether it reaches the minimum length; it cannot establish its quality.

items.stem: Which statement correctly combines the task, time and length requirements?
options: One essay is required in 30 minutes, with exactly 150 words.
One essay is required in 30 minutes, with 150 words or more.
One essay is required in 15 minutes, with 150 words or more.
One essay is required in 30 minutes, with 150 words or fewer.
items.why: 依据是 one English essay in 30 minutes 和 a minimum length of 150 words。150 words or more 就是最低字数的意思，即第二项。第一项把最低字数改成了恰好 150 词。

items.stem: What is the relationship between the two uses of 15 in the description?
options: The percentage is the essay's scale limit; the points are its share of the paper.
The percentage is the essay's length target; the points are its overall scale limit.
The percentage is the section's paper share; the points are its time allowance.
The percentage is the section's paper share; the points are its overall scale limit.
items.why: 15% of the paper 是写作在全卷中的比例，a maximum of 15 points 是评分量表的满分，即第四项。第一项把两者说反了。

groups.text: Writing material: A chart presents a fictional survey of how residents prefer to receive local notices. Printed leaflets account for 60% of preferences in the first survey and 35% in the second; electronic notices account for the remaining share in each survey. The chart supplies no explanation for this difference. Write an essay that describes the main comparison, discusses a possible reason for the change and explains one implication for those distributing local information.

items.stem: Which description identifies the main source material supplied for this writing task?
options: A chart comparing numerical preferences between two surveys
A picture contrasting residents' actions while reading notices
A situation describing a resident's request for printed notices
An outline listing established causes of changing notice preferences
items.why: A chart presents a fictional survey 和 60%、35% 说明材料是用数值比较两次调查的图表，即第一项。The chart supplies no explanation 说明材料没有列出原因，所以第四项不对。

groups.text: The 13–15 writing band describes a response that addresses the task, communicates clearly, develops ideas coherently and contains very few language errors. The 7–9 band describes unclear stretches and frequent language errors, some of which may be serious. These descriptions concern the complete response. Relevance, clarity, coherence and accuracy are dimensions of holistic judgment, without separate weights. Neither a single successful sentence nor the word count alone identifies a response's exact score.

items.stem: Which evaluation most fully matches the 13–15 band described here?
options: The response addresses the task clearly, but frequent language errors include some serious ones.
The response contains very few errors, but several explanations leave its central ideas unclear.
The response addresses the task coherently, communicates clearly and contains very few language errors.
The response develops ideas coherently and accurately, but its discussion concerns a different task.
items.why: 13–15 band 的描述有四点：addresses the task、communicates clearly、develops ideas coherently、very few language errors。第三项四点齐全，其余三项各缺一点。

items.stem: Which evaluation preserves both the clarity and language features of the 7–9 band?
options: Some explanations are unclear, while language errors are extremely rare across the response.
Some explanations are unclear, and language errors are frequent, occasionally including serious ones.
Every explanation is unclear, and every language error prevents the response from conveying meaning.
Every explanation is clear, although language errors are frequent and occasionally include serious ones.
items.why: unclear stretches 是部分表达不清，frequent language errors, some of which may be serious 是错误较多、有的严重。第二项两点都保留了。第四项把表达改成了全部清楚。

items.stem: How should relevance, clarity, coherence and accuracy be used in scoring?
options: They should be given equal separate weights and then added to produce the essay's score.
They should be judged from the strongest sentence and applied to the complete essay unchanged.
They should determine the score only after word count has identified the appropriate scoring band.
They should inform a combined judgment of the complete essay without separate numerical weights.
items.why: 依据是 dimensions of holistic judgment, without separate weights：四个维度一起用于整体评价，不分项加权，即第四项。第一项把它们改成了分项相加。
